metadata.question: Did Pittsburgh have its warmest February in 2018 (surface temperatures at 2 meters) compared to 2010 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use ERA5-Land or ERA5 hourly data for temperature at 2 meters - Location: Pittsburgh, PA (approximately -80.0°W, 40.4°N) - Compare February 2018 vs February 2010-2017 - Need mean temperature for each February 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for reanalysis data (ERA5) - Just need to filter by month (February = month 2) 3. Logic: - Calculate mean temperature for Feb 2018 - Calculate mean temperatures for each Feb 2010-2017 - Compare: if Feb 2018 > all previous years → A (Yes) - Otherwise → B (No) - Handle cases where data might be missing (C1) or calculation fails (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Pittsburgh location const pittsburgh = ee.Geometry.Point([-80.0, 40.4]); // Function to get mean temperature for a February function getFebTemp(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 2, 1); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 3, 1); const col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('temperature_2m') .filterBounds(pittsburgh); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) return null; const meanImg = col.mean(); const temp = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: pittsburgh, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); return temp; } // Get temperatures for all years const temps = {}; const years = [2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018]; for (let year of years) { const temp = getFebTemp(year); if (temp === null || temp === undefined) { console.log(`No data for Feb ${year}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Convert Kelvin to Celsius temps[year] = temp - 273.15; console.log(`Feb ${year}: ${temps[year].toFixed(2)}°C`); } // Check if 2018 was warmest const temp2018 = temps[2018]; let isWarmest = true; for (let year = 2010; year <= 2017; year++) { if (temps[year] >= temp2018) { isWarmest = false; break; } } console.log(`\n2018 warmest: ${isWarmest}`); if (isWarmest) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
